source: Cabinet Decision No. 142 of 2024 · UAE Top-up Tax
headline: A UAE-ONLY
GROUP CAN STILL

blocks.text: We only operate in the UAE, so Top-up Tax isn't for us.

items: A **foreign subsidiary**, or a foreign **branch** that is a permanent establishment, makes the group multinational.
A foreign **representative office** or an **unconsolidated** stake usually does not.
Scope still needs **EUR 750m+** revenue in **2 of the last 4** years.
